name: codex-project-flow
description: Install and safely upgrade a reusable Codex workflow with one permanent project hub and bounded execution-task generations.

interface.shortDescription: Bootstrap, upgrade, and rotate a permanent project workflow.
interface.longDescription: Adopts the bootstrap task as the permanent project hub, safely upgrades installed workflow files, and rotates bounded execution-task generations with explicit handoffs.
defaultPrompt: Use $bootstrap-project-flow in this saved local project to install the workflow and adopt this task as its permanent hub.
Use $upgrade-project-flow to safely plan or apply an upgrade without overwriting project-owned state.
